chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq uses this hadith to articulate the Shia doctrine of divine benevolence (*husn al-zann*), emphasizing that Allah’s perception is rooted in His essential goodness rather than human merit. This perspective reinforces the concept of *al-Husn al-Kull* (all is good), where even apparent hardships are viewed as manifestations of divine wisdom and mercy, a key theme in Shia theological discourse on *Adl* (Divine Justice).
